## What's free

4 containers, 100 container-hours/month, 512 MB / 0.25 vCPU; sleeps after 15 min idle

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://snapdeploy.dev/pricing> before relying on this.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
